desc: Odyssey Corporation Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 04/09/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve Agenda related to Fixation of calendar of events for AGM and Dividend.
Outcome of the Meeting of Board of Directors held on Friday, September 04, 2026 at 04:45 P.M.
Intimation of Book Closure for Purpose of AGM to be held on September 30, 2026.
Intimation of record date for the purpose of Dividend.
Notice of 31st Annual General Meeting of the Company to be held on September 30, 2026.
Submission of Annual Report for the financial year ended March 31, 2026.
